node: University services and online program management
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the university services and online program management node. The strongest direct exposure is Grand Canyon Education, which is structurally closest to an OPM/service-provider model through long-running university partner support. Strategic Education and Perdoceo are more direct education asset owners and online workforce-learning platforms than outsourced OPM vendors, but they are relevant reference/adjacent operators because they own accredited online postsecondary assets and employer-aligned education channels. Nelnet is a second-order underfollowed infrastructure candidate through campus payments, tuition management, and higher-education technology services rather than enrollment marketing or academic program execution. No buy/sell view is implied.
